chestnuts.title: Health and Safety Executive · reply of 2026-11-02

finding.negative_quote: HSE request you do not seek an update on the status of your request before the statutory / recommended date for response has expired. Please be advised that HSE is currently experiencing an increased volume of information requests. This has resulted in HSE not always being in a position to respond to requests within the statutory deadlines detailed above.
finding.conduct: Automatic receipt for a request about 1988–89 demolition notifications. Before any work is done it asks the requester not to chase and warns that replies are not always sent within the statutory time.

terms.statute: FOIA s.10(1) / EIR reg 5(2): a reply is due within 20 working days; nothing in either bars a requester from asking about progress
FOIA s.10(1) / EIR reg 5(2) 20 working days; an EIR reg 7 extension needs complexity and volume, notified within the 20 days
